method: Mean raw token vectors across all 20 samples per context; subtract gene mean across contexts within cohort/layer; joint GTEx+TCGA PCA50/UMAP per layer
limitations: Independent layouts by layer; visual separation is not a quantitative effect size; averaged contexts hide within-context heterogeneity
unit: one gene-in-context point: gene token averaged across all 20 frozen samples in that context
sample_selection: all 400 samples in the frozen balanced benchmark manifest
projection: Joint GTEx+TCGA PCA50 and UMAP per layer, not t-SNE
warning: Independent UMAP layouts; visual separation is not an effect size. L0 residuals are zero by construction.
